completion_limit: This is a deterministic same-budget comparator run only. It is not an Ember improvement and not overall baseline completion.

deterministic_patch.rationale: Simple non-agent deterministic hyperparameter comparator under identical bounded budget.

local_path_policy: Checked-in receipt redacts machine-local paths; work-template and source repo are inputs only.

patches.new: compile = False  # governed bounded run disables compile overhead
patches.old: compile = True  # do not torch compile the model on macbooks
num_samples = 10  # number of samples to draw
max_new_tokens = 500  # number of tokens generated in each sample

patches.new: dropout = 0.1  # deterministic comparator patch: lower dropout under same budget
patches.old: dropout = 0.2  # for pretraining 0 is good, for finetuning try 0.1+
